zotero.abstractNote: We present Lodos, a lightweight, GPU-accelerated simulator designed for contact-rich interactions with detailed meshes. Lodos leverages a primal formulation of the exact frictional contact problem, enabling efficient and accurate simulation of complex rigid-body systems. By exploiting massive parallelism on the GPU, Lodos achieves high simulation throughput, making it suitable for large-scale reinforcement learning and robotics applications.
